source: After a rather uneventful fight, where Sam practically danced through the corridor full of moss, rock and miasma monsters, he arrived in another chamber.
target: Post pugnam haud memorabilem, in qua Sam quasi saltavit per corridorum plenum monstris ex musco, saxo, et miasmate compositis, ad aliam conclavam pervenit.

source: The arch opened in the middle of the room, on one of the elongated sides.
target: Arcus in medio conclavis aperiebatur, in una ex lateribus elongatis.

source: And before he was besieged by another mass of monsters, this time shaped like snakes, though still made of rock, moss and black dripping miasma, Sam saw several broken slabs of stone evenly spaced out in the middle of the room, surrounded by smaller slabs of stone.
target: Et antequam ab alia multitudine monstrorum obsidione premeretur, hoc tempore ut angues formati—tamen ex saxo, musco et nigra miasmata stillantia facti—Sam vidit complura laminae lapideae fractae in media conclavi aequo intervallo distributae, circumdatae lamellis lapideis minoribus.

source: He had a moment for a fleeting thought: “Eating Hall!” Then the monsters were on him.
target: Brevi cogitatione permotus est: “Cena Aula!” Deinde monstra eum aggressi sunt.

source: Though thankfully, this time there was no giant golem.
target: Tamen, gratiose, hoc tempore nullus ingens golem aderat.

source: Shadow Burst was still on cooldown from his entrance into the chamber, he had to do a little fancy footwork.
target: Shadow Burst adhuc in refectio erat ex introitus in conclave, itaque parvum, elegantem motum pedum efficere debuit.

source: Thankfully, he had the skills for it.
target: Bene, peritiam ad hoc faciendum possidebat.

source: With a giant sidestep, he moved aside from the archway, neatly dodging the deluge of giant rock snakes that went through the same place that he was a moment before.
target: Magno latere passu, a arcui recedens, ordine vitavit inundationem anguium lapideorum ingentium, qui per locum eodem, ubi paulisper ante versatus erat, transibant.

source: Continuing the movement, he spun around with mana flowing through his sword, cleaving through another group of monsters.
target: Motum continuans, circum se vertit, dum mana per gladium eius fluebat, aliam multitudinem monstrorum secans.

source: With his other hand, Sam unleashed a wave of mana that flung the monsters that were planning to charge at him from his “unprotected” side.
target: Ex altera manu, Sam undam mana dimisit, quae monstros ab latere suo “non protegto” ad eum impetum paratos proiecerunt.

source: “So they can plan…” he realized while never stopping his sword dance.
target: ("Ita consilium capere possint…") animadvertit, dum saltum gladii sui numquam intermittebat.

source: Sam gave his thanks to all his skills that decreased stamina consumption, otherwise he would have been long dead by now.
target: Sam gratiam egit omnibus suis artibus, quae consumptionem vigoris minuere solebantur, nam alioquin iam multo temporis mortuus fuisset.

source: He hacked and slashed through the throng of monsters, flinging magic every which way, cutting down the obviously corrupted rock elementals by the dozens.
target: Sam per turbam monstrorum caedebat et secabat, magiam in omnes partes proiciebat, elementales lapideos, manifeste corruptos, per decenas deiciebat.

source: Then, as most of the monsters in the chamber were falling apart, there was a lull in the battle.
target: Tum, cum pleraque monstrorum in conclavi dispergerentur, quietudo in pugna apparuit.

source: Sam stood there for a moment panting with weapon and magic ready, and Lucky pacing behind him, growling menacingly, though Sam could see that the smoky‐looking wolf was rather proud of the mounds of monsters that he had slain.
target: Sam ibi paulisper stetit, anhelans, cum arma et magia parata essent, et Lucky post eum vagans, minaciter rugiens; tamen Sam videre poterat lupum, aspectu fumo similem, montes monstrorum interfectorum superbus esse.

source: Then the respite was over, and another roar shook the chamber.
target: Tum quies cessavit, et alius rugitus conclave concusserat.

source: This time instead of giant rock snakes, he was met with hundreds, maybe even thousands of small snakes pouring out of the archway at the other end of the room like a tidal wave made of rock, stone and miasma, peppered with the dark green of moss that was slowly chewed up by the undulating mass of monsters.
target: Hoc tempore, pro ingentibus anguibus lapideis, centenae—fortasse etiam milia—parvorum anguibus occurrerunt, quae ex arcui in altera parte conclavis effluent, instar undae ex saxo, lapide, et miasmate factae, punctis viridi obscuri musci sparsae, quod ab undulante multitudine monstrorum lente masticabatur.

source: Sam couldn’t help but exclaim.
target: Sam non potuit non exclamare.

source: “Damn! Lucky, back in the shadow!”
target: Maledictum! Lucky, in umbram redi!

source: Lucky followed the command instantly, jumping head‐first into his shadow.
target: Lucky mandato statim secutus est, capite primo in umbram suam saliens.

source: Having only a split second to react, Sam poured as much mana as he safely could into his left hand and immediately unleashed it against the mass of monsters heading to devour him.
target: Habens tantum momentum ad agendum, Sam quantum mana tute fieri poterat in manum sinistram infudit, et statim illud contra multitudinem monstrorum, quae ad eum devorandum contendebant, dimisit.

source: The mass was flung back instantly, but their numbers were so high that it only stopped them for a few seconds.
target: Multitudo statim retrorsum proiecta est, sed numerus eorum tam magnus erat ut eos paucis tantum secundis sisteret.

source: But that was enough for Sam.
target: Sed id suffecit Sam.

source: Because when he attacked the monsters, he didn’t let the mana dissipate.
target: Nam cum monstros oppugnavit, mana dissipari non sinit.

source: After all, the monsters were made of rock, and he knew how to manipulate that with mana.
target: Nam monstri ex saxo facti erant, et sciebat quomodo id cum mana regere posset.

source: So, using that second as the tidal wave was stopped, he had his mana seep into their bodies.
target: Ita, ut illo momento qua unda maris sistita erat, mana eius in corpora eorum infudit.

source: There was resistance, of course, but thanks to his Mana Disruption skill, and the fact they were small, disposable minions for the controlling intelligence behind the miasma (at least according to his current theory) he managed to wrestle control over the rock that made up their bodies almost instantly.
target: Oppositio quidem exstitit, sed, propter peritiam Mana Disruption et eo quod erant parvi ministri regiminis miasmata (saltem secundum theoriam eius praesentem), celeriter imperium super saxa, quae corpora eorum constituebant, subigere potuit.

source: Using his control, he made them all do one thing.
target: Sua potestate utendo, eos omnes unum facere iussit.

source: Explode!
target: Detona!

source: The moment he gave the mental order, he began moving, channeling mana into his shield, raising his own Earth Wall and crouching behind a piece of stone that may or may not have been a table once upon a time.
target: Momento quo iussum mentis dedit, coepit movere, mana in scutum suum canalisans, proprium murum terrae levans, atque se sub lapide, qui olim mensa fortasse fuisse potuit, reclinavit.

source: He was still peppered by not insignificant chunks of rock as the front of the tidal wave exploded, taking with it the second half in a glorious explosion that itself shook the ruin just as much as the previous roar.
target: Adhuc infestatus erat non parvis fragmentis saxi, dum pars frontis undae explosa est, secunda partem in explosione gloriosa, quae ruinam aeque concusserat ac prius rugitus, proiecit.

source: Granted, a few stragglers remained, but as Sam stood from his already crumbling hiding place, renewing his slightly depleted Mana Shield, once again happy that he didn’t learn the limited Mage Armor spell, he could simply stomp on those monsters that remained.
target: Certe pauci remanserunt, sed cum Sam ex latibulo suo iam corrumpto surrexit, scutum Mana paullo depletum renovans, atque iterum laetus quod non didicerat limitatam incantationem “Mage Armor”, simpliciter illos monstros pedibus calcitare poterat.

source: Walking around the rubble that was a few seconds ago his cover, shaking loose dust from his armor, he looked around the room and took in how almost everything was covered by a fine layer of dust and miasma, though the miasma seemed to be evaporating making it seem as if the room was covered by dark fog.
target: Circumambulans ruinas, quae paulo abhinc tegmen eius fuerant, pulverem ex armis evellens, circumspiciens conclavem animadvertit quomodo fere omnia tenuo strato pulveris et miasmata operirentur, quamquam miasma evanesce videbatur, quasi conclave caliginosum velaretur.

source: Sam spent another minute, ready for anything, waiting for the other shoe to drop, but nothing else came through the archway opposite of him.
target: Sam aliam minutam egit, paratus ad omnia, exspectans alterum calceum cadentem, sed nihil aliud per arcum oppositum ejus advenerat.

source: After doing a sweep with his mana, he finally let down his sword and let out a deep, shuddering sigh.
target: Postquam mana circumcurrebat, demum gladium suum deiecit et suspirum profundum, tremulantemque, edidit.

source: “Fuuuuu…gh”
target: “Fuuuuu…gh”

source: He took a look at his sword and immediately threw it away in disgust.
target: Gladium suum intuens, statim illud fastidio abiicebat.

source: The steel was chipped and there was a giant hairline crack running through the entire length of the blade.
target: Ferrum gladii fractum erat et ingens fissura tenuissima per totam laminae longitudinem traiciebat.

source: The only thing that probably let him use it was the mana running through it, reinforcing it.
target: Unum quod eum uti sinit, fere certe, erat mana per illud fluens, quod id roborabat.

source: Ignoring the clanging of the sword falling on the stone floor, he fished out another mass-manufactured steel sword.
target: Neglegens clangorem gladii in saxo cadentis, alium gladium ex ferro massam fabricatum extraxit.

source: He swung it around, getting a feel for its balance, then did a quick loot check.
target: Ille circumiecit, sensum aequilibrii eius explorans, deinde celerem inspectionem praediorum fecit.

source: Sadly, nothing dropped.
target: Heu, nihil cecidit.

source: Cursing the RNGods, he primed his Mana Shield and the multitude of senses and began, once again, to stride forward.
target: Deos RNG maledicens, scutum Mana et multitudinem sensuum praeparavit, et iterum incedere coepit.

source: Sam quickly fought through several rooms following the battle in the eating hall.
target: Sam celeriter per plura conclavia pugnavit, post pugnam in “Eating Hall”.

source: In the first room after it, he was beset by another tidal wave of rock snakes, this time from two sides, and spitting miasma at him.
target: In primo conclavio post illud, alter unda maris anguibus lapideis, hoc tempore ex duabus partibus, eum obsederunt, miasmata in eum sputantes.

source: His Mana Shield got its fair share of exercise, as while the spits were fairly linear, he couldn’t dodge every droplet.
target: Scutum Mana eius suam partem exercitationis accepit, quoniam, dum miasmata quasi linearia erant, non potuit omnes guttas evadere.

source: He had a feeling that miasma touching him would be a bad thing…
target: Sensit miasma, quod eum attingeret, rem mala futuram esse…

source: Sam mainly kited the snakes around until they were all in the room, then used the same tactic as before.
target: Sam praecipue angues circum lusus est, donec omnes in conclavio congregatae erant, deinde eandem rationem adhibuit.

source: Throw them back and make them explode.
target: Reiice eos et detona eos.

source: It was glorious…
target: Gloriosum erat…

source: The next room after that was absent of rock snakes.
target: Proximum conclave post illud nullos angues lapideos continebat.

source: Instead, the golems returned with a vengeance.
target: Immo, golem redierunt cum ultione.

source: And weapons.
target: Et arma.

source: Granted, they were barely worth being called weapons.
target: Certe, vix dignae erant ut arma appellarentur.

source: They were mostly crude rods masquerading as spears and shorter rods that acted like swords, a few monsters even sported clubs made of rocks.
target: Praecipue erant vergae rudis, speciem telorum induentes, et vergae breviores quae quasi gladios afferebant, atque pauca monstra etiam clavas ex saxo gerebant.

source: Sam had to use his Wind Blade and Mana Slash generously to keep his distance because while his speed was better than the average at his level, his own reaction speed wasn’t good enough to keep track of every monster trying to transform him into minced meat and dodge their attacks.
target: Sam oportuit ut Lamine Ventorum et Mana Slash liberaliter ad distantiam servandam adhiberet, quoniam, cum celeritas eius gradus suos superaret, propria reactionis celeritas non sufficiebat ut omnes monstros, qui eum in carnem minutam convertere et impetus eorum evadere conabantur, sequi posset.

source: But in the end, he stood triumphantly on top of a small mountain of golem corpses with a rapidly evaporating miasma around him.
target: Sed demum triumphanter stetit super parvam montem cadaverorum golem, circum eum miasma celeriter evaporans.

source: This time, being ready for the phenomena, he took a small bottle, and with the help of his mana, managed to coral a small amount of the dark material into it.
target: Hoc tempore, paratus ad phaenomena, parvam lagenae caput tulit, et cum auxilio mana, parvam quantitatem materiae obscurae in eam aggregare potuit.

source: The moment the miasma was in the bottle, he inserted the stopper and with his knife quickly etched a very small and crude seal on it made of runes.
target: Momento quo miasma in lagena erat, obturator inseruit et cultello suo celeriter parvum atque rudimentarium sigillum ex runis incidit.

source: It was basically a three‐rune seal.
target: Fundamentaliter, erat sigillum trium runarum.

source: One was his Heart Rune, another Rune for the mana to fuel the seal and the rune for Sealing.
target: Una erat runa Cordis eius, altera erat runa mana ad sigillum alendum, et tertia runa ad sigillandum.

source: It wasn’t the most sophisticated seal or rune sequence, but it would work in a pinch.
target: Non erat sigillum aut series runarum maxime sophisticata, sed in necessitate prodesse poterat.

source: And it would also allow him enough time to bring the sample to somebody who knows about things like that…
target: Et etiam tempus ei dabit ut exemplar ad aliquem, qui talia novit, afferre possit…

source: Then he headed for the next archway.
target: Deinde ad proximum arcum contulit.

source: The next part of his journey brought him through several smaller, interconnected rooms.
target: Pars sequens itineris eius eum per plura minora et inter se conexa conclavia duxit.

source: To his eyes, they looked like rooms that somebody used to live in.
target: Oculis eius, videbantur sicut conclavia in quibus aliquis olim habitare solebat.

source: Slabs of stone took the shape of beds, and shelves were carved into the walls, though nothing organic remained that would allow him to figure out who lived in the ruins before they became a ruin.
target: Laminae lapideae formam lecti obtinebant, et cellae in parietibus incisi erant, quamquam nihil organicum reliquum erat, quod ei patefaceret quis ante ruinas habitaverit.

source: His current running theory was that it was a headquarters that the rangers of the old used to protect the ironwood forest that somehow got corrupted.
target: Theoria eius praesentis erat quod esset sedes, qua veteres custodes (rangers) silvae “ironwood” protegere solebant, et qua ratione corrupta fuisset, nesciebatur.

source: The whys and hows were currently beyond him, though he had a few suspects…
target: Causae et modi nunc extra eum erant, quamquam paucos suspectos habebat…

source: The fight in the rooms was basically one giant hide‐and‐seek game.
target: Pugna in conclavi fere quasi magnum ludum celandi et inveniendi erat.

source: Rock monsters in the shapes of spiders, both giant and small, hid in every corner, on every ceiling, and behind every chunk of rubble big enough to hide behind.
target: Monstra saxea in formis aranearum – tam ingentia quam parva – in omni angulo, in omni parte laquearum, et post omne fragmentum ruinae, quod late operiri posset, se celaverunt.

source: He was constantly using his sensing skills, trying to stretch them beyond their actual use.
target: Continuo artes suas sensitivas adhibebat, conans eas ultra finem usus extendere.

source: Sam was pretty sure if the skill hadn’t leveled up when he was looking for the ruin, he would be in much bigger trouble with the spiders.
target: Sam satis certus erat, si ars non in gradum elevata esset, dum ruinas quaereret, in magis gravibus difficultatibus cum araneis versatus fuisset.

source: Now he just had to grab the smaller spiders and explode them (having a little fun with the noise they made when they exploded) while simply fighting the bigger ones with his spells.
target: Nunc tantum minoribus araneis prehendendis erat et explodere eos (paulo ludens cum strepitu, quem fecerunt cum explosi essent) dum maiora incantationibus pugnabat.

source: The intelligence behind the monsters didn’t seem the smartest, as all spiders used the same tactic when fighting him.
target: Intelligentia quae monstris imperabat non apparet esse prudens, nam omnes araneae eandem rationem in pugna adhibebant.

source: Then, after a few hours of fighting, he stood before the biggest archway he had seen in the ruins.
target: Deinde, post paucas horas pugnae, stetit coram maximam arcum, quem in ruinis viderat.

source: He made sure to check his equipment, change his sword to a fresh one, chug a potion, and warn Lucky.
target: Curae fuit ut apparatum suum inspiceret, gladium in novum mutaret, poculum potionis biberet, et Lucky admoneret.

source: Then, priming his Mana Shield, he stepped through the threshold.
target: Deinde, scutum Mana praeparans, per limen intravit.

source: Sam found himself in an enormous room, where even his first step into the chamber echoed.
target: Sam se invenit in conclave ingenti, ubi etiam primus eius passus in conclave resonabat.

source: Sadly, he didn’t have enough time to admire the local decoration practices, as the moment he set foot into the room, two roars shook him, the room and the mountain.
target: Heu, non tempus habuit ut ornamenta localia admiraret, nam momento quo pedem in conclave posuit, duo rugitus eum, conclavem et montem concusserunt.

source: At both ends of the giant chamber stood two very familiar golems.
target: In utraque parte conclavis ingentis duo golem noti steterunt.

source: Though their cores were much less exposed than the first one.
target: Quamquam centra eorum longe minus patefacta erant quam primi.

source: Both raised their hands, ending in sharp‑looking claws made of almost metallic‑looking rock and dripping with miasma.
target: Ambae manus elevaverunt, terminantes in unguibus acutis, ex saxo paene metallino aspectu factis et miasmata stillantibus.

source: “Note to self, don’t get hit with that,” he spoke out loud, gulping a little, then glanced down at his shadow.
target: “Nota mihi: noli hoc te percutere,” locutus est voce, paulo guttans, deinde ad umbram suam aspiciens.

source: “Lucky!” The wolf’s head immediately surfaced from the shadow, his eyes looking at him with serious attention.
target: “Lucky!” Caput lupi statim ex umbra ortum est, oculis gravibus in eum spectantibus.

source: “Go far, and attack when there is an opportunity.”
target: “Vade longe, et oppugna cum occasio appareat.”

source: The wolf let out a quiet bark and did something that surprised Sam.
target: Lupus quietum latratum edidit et aliquid fecit, quod Sam miratus est.

source: Instead of jumping out of Sam’s shadow, the wolf dove back into the shadow, disappearing completely.
target: Proinde, cum non ex umbra Sam insiliit, lupus rursus in umbram demersit, omnino evanescens.

source: Sam was about to call out to him when he spotted Lucky emerging, with a wolfish grin on the other end of the chamber from the shadow hiding one of the corners of the room.
target: Sam iam ad eum clamandum parabat, cum Lucky emergentem animadvertit, cum risu lupino in altera parte conclavis, ex umbra anguli celati.

source: Sadly, he didn’t have time to check his notifications, as he had to deal with two rather angry golems.
target: Heu, non tempus habuit ut nuntiationes inspiceret, nam cum duobus golem iracundis agere debebat.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: “Shadow Burst!”

source: Using the speed gained from the skill, he jumped behind the golem on the left, and he immediately had to crouch, as the golem swiped its claws through the air where his head should have been.
target: Arte adeptus velocitate, post golem sinistrum insiluit, et statim se incurvare debuit, quoniam golem unguibus per aerem feriebat, ubi caput eius esse debebat.

source: Apparently, they had been upgraded…
target: Apparenter, meliorati erant…

source: Sam jumped back, sending a blast of mana at the offending arm, pushing up, then sending several consecutive slashes at the area where a visibly thick layer of rock mixed with miasma protected the core.
target: Sam retraxit, et impetum mana in brachium nocens misit, surgens, deinde plures ictus consecutivos in locum, ubi stratum saxi crassum, miasmate mixtum, nucleum protegebat, affecit.

source: Fortunately, the slashes managed to gouge a little line into the material, so he only had to whittle the defenses down.
target: Fortunate, ictus parvam lineam in materiam effoderunt, ut defensionem tantum minuere posset.

source: Sadly, he couldn’t continue with his bombardment, as the golem recovered and its friend was also on the way.
target: Heu, non potuit bombardationem continuare, quoniam golem se recuperavit et amicus eius etiam adveniebat.

source: Sam had to dodge twice, once for each arm as they came down with a wide slashing motion, slamming into the ground and sending debris everywhere.
target: Sam bis evadere debuit, unum pro singulis brachiis, eorum late ictu descendentium in terram contundentes et ruinas ubique proiecentes.

source: Thankfully, his Flow skill allowed him some manner of warning.
target: Gratias, ars Flow ei modum praemonitionis concessit.

source: He watched as the golem raised both of its hands, then mechanically turned towards him, while the other one was thundering towards them.
target: Aspiciens, vidit golem utrumque manum elevare, deinde mechanice ad eum converti, dum alter in eorum partem tonitruans accedebat.

source: For a moment, he despaired a little, not knowing how to win quickly and without putting himself into undue danger, but then an idea sparked in his mind.
target: Per momentum paulum desperavit, nesciens quomodo celeriter vinceret et sine supervacuo periculo se poneret, sed deinde idea in mente eius accensa est.

source: Shadow Burst was on cooldown, but the golems were slow enough for his speed with only the Body Enhancement.
target: Shadow Burst in refectio erat, sed golem satis tarde erant pro celeritate eius cum sola augmentatione corporis.

source: So, with a plan quickly solidifying in his mind, Sam launched himself towards the nearest golem, dodging another swipe in the process.
target: Ita, consilio celeriter in mente solidato, Sam se ad proximum golem contulit, et alium ictum vitans.

source: The golem struck but wasn’t fast enough to hit him, and Sam managed to run past the golem, making sure to stay as close to the body as possible, striking it a few times with his sword, but his eyes were on the other golem.
target: Golem percussit, sed non fuit tam celer ut eum feriret, et Sam potuit praeter golem currere, curesque ut quam proxime ad corpus maneret, aliquoties gladio feriens, sed oculi eius in altero golem erant.

source: The other golem, seeing him coming closer (while the first one was in the process of turning) raised its clawed hands toward Sam and began to charge.
target: Alter golem, eum propius accedentem videns (dum primus conversurus esset), manus unguibus in Sam elevavit et impetum facere coepit.

source: Sam grinned, then skidded to a halt and turned halfway to make sure he saw both golems.
target: Sam risum fecit, deinde subito sistens et semisvertens ut utrumque golem intueceretur.

source: Then, in the next moment, a lot of things happened.
target: Deinde, in proximo momento, multa acciderunt.

source: The first golem finished turning and was facing him and the other golem.
target: Primus golem conversionem perfecit et ad eum ac ad alterum golem conversus erat.

source: The second golem reached his position with arms, claws dripping malevolent miasma, already descending.
target: Secundus golem ad locum eius pervenit, brachiis, unguibus miasmata malevola stillantia, iam descendens.

source: His magic lashed out under his direction, latching onto the outside of the arm of the second golem, and giving a not‑so‑gentle tug while jumping backwards and gleefully watching the spectacle.
target: Magia eius, sub eius directione, prostrata est, ad externum brachii secundi golem conglutinans, et non tam mitis trahitionem faciens, dum retrorsum saliens et spectaculum laete contemplans.

source: The tug on the arms of the second golem was enough to make the swipe an overextended movement, practically launching the arms of the golem directly at the second golem leaning towards his previous position.
target: Tractio in brachiis secundi golem satis fuit ut ictus in motum nimis extensum verti posset, fere mittens brachia golem directe in secundum golem, qui ad priorem positionem inclinabatur.

source: The two golems, claws meeting hardened rock, clashed with a tremendous noise.
target: Duo golem, cum unguibus saxum duratum contingentes, ingenti strepitu collisere.

source: Sam, using the distraction, sprinted behind the back of the first golem and unleashed as much mana as possible concentrated at the tip of his sword.
target: Sam, distractioni utefactus, post dorsum primi golem celeriter cucurrit et quantum mana fieri poterat, ad apicem gladii concentratum, dimisit.

source: Using as much strength as possible, he thrust it towards the core of the monster as the dust settled down around them from the clash.
target: Quantum robur potestatem haberet, gladium in nucleum monstri iniecit, dum pulvis ex concursu circa eos consediit.

source: The sword went through the damaged and slightly worn down armor, piercing the core and causing the magic holding the golem together to fall apart.
target: Gladius per armaturam laesam et leviter exsaccatam transiit, nucleum perforans et magiam, quae golem coniungebat, dissolvere faciens.

source: Sadly, it also resulted in him getting splashed with the miasma leaking from the joints and cracks in the rock that was the body of the golem.
target: Heu, id etiam in eum effecit ut miasma, ex iunctionibus et fissuris in saxo, quod corpus golem constituebat, effluentem, eum tinctum haberet.

source: The second golem stood there for a few seconds, enough time to allow Sam to clean himself with a brief burst of mana and the Clean spell, then the surrounding mana thickened and his Flow skill all but shouted at him to dodge.
target: Secundus golem ibi aliquot secundis stetit, sufficiens ut Sam se purgaret cum brevi impetu mana et incantatione “Clean”, deinde mana circumstans densior facta est, et ars Flow ei modum praemonitionis concessit.

source: He did so, but thanks to the excess mana, the golem was fast enough to clip him in the sides, his Mana Shield dipping but not falling and throwing him to the ground, a little dazed.
target: Id fecit, sed ex nimia mana, golem celer erat ut latus eius laederet, scutum Mana eius deiectum sed non delapsum, eum in terram iactans, paulo attonitum.

source: Thankfully, Lucky chose this exact moment to jump from the shadow of the golem at its back, striking it hard enough to send it staggering, granting Sam enough respite to gather himself, then dove back into the shadow with a joyful howl.
target: Gratias, Lucky hoc eodem momento eligit ut ex umbra golem, quae in tergo eius erat, insiliret, eum satis dure feriens ut titubans iaceretur, Samque quietem concedens, deinde cum laeta ululatu rursus in umbram demersit.

source: Still fast from the buff gained from the excess mana, the golem straightened and, with mechanical fluidity, turned around, and once again began charging at him.
target: Adhuc celer, ex nimia mana auxilio recepto, golem se rectificavit et, cum mechanica fluiditate, conversus est, atque iterum ad eum impetum facere coepit.

source: Sam considered his options, cursing the cooldown of the Shadow Burst, then had a stupid idea.
target: Sam optiones suas consideravit, tempora refectionis Shadow Burst maledicens, deinde stultam ideam finxit.

source: Focusing on his mana, he slapped his hand on the ground in front of him and exclaimed.
target: Manam suam intendens, manum in terram ante se pulsavit et exclamavit.

source: “Earth Wall!”
target: “Murus Terrae!”

source: Instantly, a very well-made and sturdy wall made of the ground rose directly under the leg of the golem.
target: Statim, murus terrae valde bene confectus et firmus, directe sub crure golem ortus est.

source: The golem, thanks to the speed it was going, couldn’t react in time, thus was unbalanced when it stepped on the wall Sam created, and was sent careening.
target: Golem, propter celeritatem suam, non potuit tempore reagere, ita in muro quem Sam creaverat, inaequabiliter incidens, proiciebatur.

source: Sam watched with satisfaction, crouching on the ground, as the golem fell sideways, trying to use its arms to stop it, but the weight of its body, especially with the added armor, was too much for the fast-moving arms.
target: Sam, cum satisfactione aspiciens, in terra se curvans, vidit golem lateraliter cadere, conans brachios suos uti ad illud sistere, sed pondus corporis eius, praesertim cum armatura addita, nimis grave videbatur ad brachios celeriter movendos.

source: They were practically pulverized when the giant rock body landed on them.
target: Practicabiliter illi in pulverem redacti sunt, cum ingens corpus saxi in eos cecidit.

source: To his senses, it was as if the mana around the golem became iridescent with rage and Sam couldn’t help but chuckle.
target: Sensibus eius, quasi mana circa golem iridescens ira facta esset, et Sam non potuit non ridere.

source: “If my enemy is angry, then I’m doing something good!”
target: “Si inimicus meus iratus est, tunc aliquid boni facio!”

source: He stood up and with a few measured steps he was standing next to the golem, and the next moment, his sword channeling once again, too much mana struck down, piercing another core.
target: Surgens paucis gradu mensuratis prope golem stetit, et in proximo momento, gladium suum iterum canalisans, nimis mana percussit, alterum nucleum perforans.

source: The moment the sword’s tip made contact with the core, the mana in the golem’s body fled, flowing somewhere in the distance, and the chamber fell silent.
target: Momento quo apicem gladii nucleo contingit, mana in corpore golem effugit, alicubi in longinquo fluens, et conclave silentium adeptum est.

source: The only thing that could be heard was Sam’s tired panting and Lucky’s excited prowling in the shadows.
target: Unum tantum, quod audiri poterat, erat anhelitus fatigatus Sam et Lucky excitatus in umbris vagans.

source: And among the detritus that was the two golem’s bodies, Sam could see two very familiar shining lights.
target: Et inter detritus corporum duorum golem, Sam duo lucida, valde nota lumina videbat.
